up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) that have at least one mechanism of action recorded as 'PARTIAL AGONIST' in drug_mechanism. For each such drug, return the following columns: drug_name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), drug_chembl_id (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), target_name (pref_name from target_dictionary), target_chembl_id (chembl_id from target_dictionary), target_organism (organism from target_dictionary), and canonical_smiles (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Return one row per drug-target combination. Do not add any additional filters and do not limit the number of rows. Use the tables molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, and compound_structures with the appropriate joins: drug_mechanism.molregno to molecule_dictionary.molregno, drug_mechanism.tid to target_dictionary.tid, and molecule_dictionary.molregno to compound_structures.molregno.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS drug_name, md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.organism AS target_organism, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST';
